metadata.semantic_summary: On 2026-03-13, NimbleSearch's dedicated tenant on dsp-6-us-east experienced a surge in 5xx errors primarily 502/503 caused by API gateway backpressure amplifying runtime thread exhaustion. Large batch embedding jobs with batch size 256 triggered many short-lived threads, exhausting process thread limits on runtime nodes. The autoscaler lagged in scaling up capacity, worsening the issue. Immediate mitigations included scaling nodes, tenant-level rate limiting, rolling back prefetch config, and deploying a hotfix to enforce backpressure respect and bounded thread pools. Post-fix, error rates returned to baseline within 20 minutes. The incident was mitigated by 19:50 UTC with follow-up actions planned for autoscaler policy and runbook updates.

metadata.semantic_summary: This Slack conversation in the eng-infra channel documents a network incident involving intermittent packet loss and interface flaps on ToR switch tor-04 affecting traffic between racks 4a and 4b. The internal L4 load balancer VIPs gen-infer-01 and gen-infer-02 experienced backend healthcheck failures and connection resets. Investigation revealed MTU and ECN related packet fragmentation and truncation issues likely caused by hardware bugs on tor-04. Network engineers ran diagnostic commands, captured pcaps, and performed iperf3 tests confirming path MTU blackhole behavior. Temporary mitigations included disabling ECN and applying MTU clamps on load balancer frontends, which improved retransmit rates. A ticket (NET-1983) was created to track the suspected hardware bug, and a follow-up ticket (INFRA-447) was opened to replace the tor-04 linecard and test vendor firmware patches. Monitoring and alerting improvements were also planned.
